source: Per-hole features read off the club's eighteen 2026 hole plans (johannesbergsgolf.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Bana-N.jpg; bana-11.jpg is lower-case on the server) on 2026-09-05. Every plan is an aerial photograph with the tee discs, the flag, the fairway distance markers and the OB stakes drawn on it; nothing here is measured, it is what the club draws. Sides are the PLAYER's (holes 1, 2 and 7 play south, so their left is world east). 'model' says what johannesbergbuild/course-model.json carries after the 2026-09-05 traces and 'laser' what the 1 m DTM says about the same feature (johannesbergbuild/terrain-check.json), so the three sources can be read against each other in one row.
